_source: Code of Practice for Site Supervision 2009 (2024 Edition, rev. Aug 2024), BD, paras 4.1-4.6, 8.4-8.8, Table 8.1; Technical Memorandum for Supervision Plans 2009 (TM), Tables 1 and 2. Read via automated extraction 2026-11-05/06. TM Table 1 rows were read twice with different prompts (a cell-by-cell CSV and a per-stream description) and agreed; the one cell marked uncertain could not be aligned. Check against the TM PDF before a statutory submission. TM Table 1 and its Class I minor works rows checked against rendered PDF pages 28-29 on 2026-11-06; the Class I RGE cell is T2 at level 5 as published.

T1.min: certificate or diploma + 2 years relevant experience

T4.min: degree + 4 years, or a registered professional

5.text: full-time inspection during site working hours

streams.AS: Authorized Signatory of the registered contractor (RGBC / RSC)

scale_basic_values._note: Table 8.1. Scale factor = estimated value / basic value, capped at 2 (para 8.5). Factor 1 = full-day TCP inspection each occasion (8.7); below 1 allows shorter visits, never fewer (8.7-8.8).

demolition.measure: max floor area demolished per storey

gifw_pits.measure: trial pits, coreholes, slope strippings concurrently (no drillholes)

slope_repair.measure: total cost (slope / retaining wall / buried services repair)

elsw.measure: average cost per month (excavation & lateral support)

large_dia_bored_piles.measure: average cost per month (large diameter bored / barrette piles)

other_piles.measure: average cost per month (piles other than the above)

curtain_wall.measure: total aggregated surface area (curtain wall / cladding)

rules.text: Supervision plan names each TCP and the frequency / extent of supervision; submit before or with the consent application.
AP lodges the plan with or before the first consent application; minor works (simplified requirements): ≥ 7 days before commencement.
Confirm TCP appointments as an annex to the plan or within 7 days of commencement.
AP / RSE / RGE / AS notify the BA of any subsequent change of TCP.
Revised plan when a revised contract sum changes the scale factor and resources.
Full-time TCPs stationed on site; minimum frequency in TM Table 1 must not be reduced.
Temporary works supporting a tower crane: designer and independent checker each a registered professional engineer (civil / structural) with ≥ 5 years relevant experience.
Soil nailing: at least one TCP T3 (RGE stream) and one TCP T1 (RSC stream) resident full-time at every stage.
Significant geotechnical works: RGE normally provides TCP T3 and T5.

tm_table1._key: stream -> {grade: minimum frequency level}; 'principal' = level for the AS / AP / RSE / RGE personally; null = no requirement in that stream

geotech_foundation.label: Building works with significant geotechnical content: foundation (Notes 4, 5)

geotech_others.label: Building works with significant geotechnical content: others (Note 4)

foundation.label: Foundation works (other than with significant geotechnical content)

all_other.label: All other building works (other than minor works) or street works

minor_class1.label: Class I minor works: works where only an AP is required

minor_class1_rse.label: Class I minor works: additional TCPs where an RSE is required

minor_class1_rge.label: Class I minor works: additional TCPs where an RGE is required

notes.1: Levels: 1 as and when required, 2 monthly, 3 fortnightly, 4 weekly, 5 full-time during site working hours
notes.2: Higher grade or more frequent inspection (up to full-time) may be required at critical stages; see CoP
notes.3: Qualifications per Table 2; guidance in CoP
notes.4: CoP defines which works have significant geotechnical content
notes.5: CoP defines which foundation works (incl. in Designated Areas) have significant geotechnical content

work_type_to_tm_row._note: Default mapping from Table 8.1 work types to TM Table 1 rows (this repo's assumption). Override per work with `tm_row`. Geotechnical types switch to geotech_* rows when `geotechnical` is true.
